candidate.architecture: native column tokens + column colour objective v1

criteria.decision: painted_fit>=probe_gate and overall_fit>=overall_gate and fit>=fit_gate -> column_supervision_makes_parent_reachable; painted_fit>=probe_gate and overall_fit>=overall_gate and fit<=fit_low -> colour_in_tokens_readout_still_blocks; painted_fit<probe_gate -> encoder_cannot_carry_colour; else inconclusive_column_supervision
criteria.probe: ridge from the body's 16 column tokens to the 7-way column label, fit on train 256, tested on fit 32, lambda 1.0, features standardised on train
criteria.baseline: P3.30 measured the same probe at 0.690 train / 0.674 fit on the body's frozen encoder; this card re-measures it at update 0 as a reproduction check
criteria.arms: A: encoder.rgb + readout, four-way answer plus the colour-classifier term; B: identical plus a 7-way column colour cross-entropy through a 63-parameter training-only head
criteria.single_variable: A and B share seed, data, order, optimiser, doses, readout and encoder; only the column term differs
criteria.served_readout: the same 59-parameter module P3.30 used; the column head never appears at evaluation
criteria.prototypes: recomputed from the current encoder every forward, so at step zero both arms equal P3.30's build
criteria.probe_metric: painted columns only (the label is one of the six palette colours); background columns are 74.6% of the fit split and are reported separately

baselines.reading: the overall figure 0.674 quoted by P3.30 is BELOW the 0.746 always-background rate, so it must not be cited as evidence that colour is decodable

control_arms.p3_30: frozen encoder, fixed palette prototypes: probe 0.674 fit, fit accuracy 0.3125
control_arms.p3_31: frozen encoder, learned scorer: probe not measured, fit accuracy 0.34375
control_arms.p3_16: pooled 8-dim encoding with a position head: head train 0.391, no byte transfer

note: pricing stage; run needs frozen status plus owner authority plus a measured cap

amendment_pre_freeze.when: after the zero-training baseline probe, before any training step
amendment_pre_freeze.reason: the probe was restated because the baseline revealed it had no floor check: overall accuracy 0.676 sits below the 0.746 always-background rate, and the painted subset scores 0.369 against a 0.208 painted majority
amendment_pre_freeze.change: the gate now applies to painted columns plus overall accuracy, and both baselines are published beside every reading

price_measured.note: probe median equals the 0.015625 s timer tick, so the curve figure is an upper estimate; cap set at 260

authorization.asked: 是否授权跑 P4.1 列级颜色监督（预计 ≤80 CPU，先定价再冻结）
authorization.scope: two arms, 7376 steps each, 260 CPU cap
authorization.note: owner approved the card; the price probe then measured 0.0156 CPU/step and the cap was set from it
